steps.what: Review staffing needs and discuss relevant employee circumstances
Decide whether to recommend a promotion transfer or hire and explain reasons
Prepare check and submit personnel action request to authorised HR route

tasks.design: Configure a request form and existing routing in {HCM} to reuse identity and organisational fields. The supervisor still considers the case, writes the recommendation and checks the exact request before submission; no model ranks workers or recommends employment outcomes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Personnel requests require repeated administrative details and finding the right HR route.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms can reuse authorised records and route a supervisor-written request.
tasks.still_hard: Fair recommendations, confidential circumstances and the effect on the employee.
tasks.human_edge: Understanding the person and discussing the reasons for a proposed action.
tasks.altitude: Less request administration; no additional employment decision rights.

reach.task: Check the proposed personnel action against the applicable process
reach.learn: What evidence and consultation the specific action needs

evidence.claim: Native HR forms and routing can reduce repeated request administration without automating employment judgement; the saving is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is supervisor recommendation and initiation; HR decisions, employee consultation and any final employment action remain in their existing process and earn no saving here.
The supervisor produces reasons and proposed action in s2, with all judgement and writing time retained.

HR's existing employee records produce employee ID, role, department and manager during unchanged employee administration; for a hire the supervisor supplies the vacancy reference in retained s3 time.
s3 counts selecting the record, entering the proposal, checking recipient and request fields, and approving submission. No structured personnel recommendation is assumed upstream.
Test native forms and routing first; missing records or unusual actions follow the current manual HR route.
Approval covers the exact request only and adds no power to promote, transfer or hire. Local access and employee consultation requirements need confirmation.
unknowns: Existing HCM forms, request volumes and local authority limits
research_questions: Do native request forms reduce repeated entry without shifting extra capture or checking to HR?

already_counted.description: Request completion, exception routing and exact-version submission check in s3

incremental.description: Check request defaults and report routing changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact employee or vacancy reference, action type, supervisor-written reasons, attachments and recipient route in the submitted request; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=55+25+12=92; gross 8 minus 1 focal upkeep gives net 7. High requires repeated email request administration; low covers infrequent requests and manual exceptions consuming the benefit. HR upkeep remains separate.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep personnel judgement while reducing request administration.
reach: Prepare clearer requests for HR advisers
role.ambitious_version: Initiate well-reasoned personnel requests through the proper human decision process.

job.title: First-Line Supervisors of Construction Trades and Extraction Workers
